channel.title: Salt Lake Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Salt Lake Tribune (sltrib.com)

item.title: BYU football player charged with rape told police ‘all sexual activity’ was consensual
item.description: The court documents against BYU wide receiver Parker Kingston was unsealed Thursday.

item.title: Utah’s massive planned homeless shelter would face strict rules under new legislation
item.description: Utah's massive planned homeless campus would face strict guardrails under a new bill from Democratic lawmakers.

item.title: Nathan Chen isn’t skating in Italy, but men’s figure skating still revolves around him
item.description: Four years after Salt Lake City figure skater Nathan Chen won Olympic gold, he'll be in Milan-Cortina for the 2026 Olympics. He won't be skating, but he will have influence on the outcome of the single men's competition.

item.title: Letter: Chemical and pesticide pollution is not contained by borders, leaving everyone at risk
item.description: Letter: Public demand for transparency and accountability in chemical use is growing. We cannot continue to allow short-term industrial efficiency to outweigh long-term human and environmental health.

item.title: Letter: Memo to Utah leaders: When bigotry is treated as a difference of opinion, it is legitimized as a political position
item.description: Letter: I have listened in on many committee hearings where my trans siblings bravely tell their stories and attempt to open the kinds of dialogues Cox encourages. The legislators in those rooms refused to engage.

item.title: Breaking with his party, Utah’s Sen. John Curtis is sinking a Trump State Department pick
item.description: Citing “insensitive remarks about the Jewish people,” Utah’s Sen. John Curtis announced Thursday he will oppose a high-level State Department nomination from President Donald Trump, likely crushing it.

item.title: Utah Jazz star Jaren Jackson Jr. could miss the rest of the NBA season
item.description: Jaren Jackson Jr. will undergo surgery during the NBA's All-Star break, the Utah Jazz announced Thursday.

item.title: Utah Jazz’s apparent tanking behavior draws criticism from NBA pundits
item.description: Jaren Jackson Jr. has watched the fourth quarters of his first two games as a member of the Utah Jazz from the bench. How does the two-time All-Star feel about that?

item.title: LDS Church President Dallin Oaks makes a controversial pick for new apostle: Clark Gilbert
item.description: In naming the second new apostle of his four-month LDS Church presidency, Dallin H. Oaks selected Clark Gilbert, the controversial commissioner of church education.

item.title: NBA commissioner says Utah Jazz ‘compromised the integrity of our games,’ fines team largest amount yet
item.description: The Utah Jazz were fined for sitting stars Lauri Markkanen and Jaren Jackson Jr. late in two recent games. Here's what the NBA and Jazz owner Ryan Smith had to say about the decision.
